title: Marital Games
coreMove: See how a relationship game protects both partners from direct closeness by making the safer role feel unavoidable.
sourcePressure: Covers Corner, Courtroom, If It Weren't For You, Look How Hard I've Tried, Sweetheart, and an unnamed intimacy-avoidance withdrawal variant in gender-neutral form.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating marital games as tricks one bad partner plays on an innocent other, instead of paired structures that preserve distance.

sourceAnchors.name: If It Weren't For You
sourceAnchors.detail: the source says one partner blames restrictions on the other, while often choosing the restricting partner because the restriction protects them from trying and failing
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: If It Weren't For You can turn a partner into the locked door the player quietly needed.

sourceAnchors.name: Courtroom
sourceAnchors.detail: the source describes couples bringing disputes to a third party for judgment so the dispute can continue under the cover of seeking help
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Courtroom sounds like a search for fairness until the verdict becomes fuel for the next hearing.

sourceAnchors.name: Sweetheart
sourceAnchors.detail: the source names an affectionate-seeming public story whose punchline hides a veiled insult the partner cannot object to without seeming humorless
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Sweetheart smiles while it delivers the little cut in front of witnesses.

exampleSpecs.domain: shared renovation decision over flooring samples

exampleSpecs.domain: couples therapist intake after three friends have already judged the same fight
exampleSpecs.audience: a partner pulling a third party into Courtroom for vindication
exampleSpecs.stakes: therapy can become the next courtroom instead of contact

exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Just tell us who was unreasonable," Julien says before taking off his coat.

exampleSpecs.domain: career-change conversation before a nursing-school deadline

exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Emily until the application deadline week to notice the browser tab was still open.

exampleSpecs.domain: dinner party anecdote where affection carries a small public cut
exampleSpecs.audience: a partner deciding whether to laugh along with Sweetheart or name it later

exampleSpecs.firstImage: Candle wax pools near the bread plate while everyone laughs half a beat too long.

exampleSpecs.domain: weekend childcare plan where visible effort replaces actual agreement
exampleSpecs.audience: a parent performing Look How Hard I've Tried at an impossible plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: one adult gets moral credit and the other remains abandoned
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sophie separates effort display from workable care by asking for the one task that will actually happen by noon.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You can hear effort in the hallway before you can see whether anything changed.

exampleSpecs.domain: long-distance relationship video call that always ends when closeness appears
exampleSpecs.audience: a partner in an unnamed withdrawal variant using fatigue to dodge direct contact
exampleSpecs.stakes: real tiredness and intimacy avoidance must be distinguished carefully

exampleSpecs.firstImage: How do you tell fatigue from the pattern that borrows fatigue as a door?
